executive-only.description: Executive alone; the environment is described but it is never told to watch it.

polling.description: System 2 does it all: executive told to poll logs and queues itself after each edit.

perception.description: Always-on sensors with System 1 (Jev) appraisal, escalation and interrupts.

deliver-all.description: Same sensors; every novel observation delivered, no escalation or interrupts.

deliver-none.description: Same sensors; nothing delivered (cost and interference control).

rules.description: Same sensors and routing; keyword/threshold alerts and a no-output watchdog instead of a decision model.
